items.quote: A defining highlight of this transformation has been the significant expansion of our lifestyle service portfolio such as: Spa at leading wellness centres, Access to members-only Social Clubs, Room upgrades at premium hotels, App-based Airport Transfers, Meals at Star Hotels, Coffee at top brands in Malls

items.statement: Deepening engagement with existing banking partners to increase wallet share through lifestyle services like Coffee on the go
items.quote: A clear example of this approach is the activation of lifestyle services such as Coffee on the go with clients who already use our lounge access infrastructure. By extending the breadth of our service catalogue within existing integrations, we increase wallet shar e, improve client stickiness, and create more diversified, recurring revenue streams without proportional incremental cost

items.statement: Launched boarding pass-based benefits program with a leading Indian bank
items.quote: Another exciting update is our recent launch of boarding pass-based benefits program with one of the leading banks in India.

items.statement: Advanced stages of enabling premium services for multiple global banks and card networks in South-East Asia
items.quote: We are also in advanced stages of enabling our premium services for multiple global banks & card network in South-East Asia - a significant development that will open a new revenue stream and validate our platform's readiness for large-scale international deployments.

items.statement: FY26 consolidated revenue INR 660.6 crores vs INR 1,291.9 crores in FY25
items.quote: For the full year FY26, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately INR 660.6 crores against INR 1,291.9 crores in FY25, the decline primarily caused due to the structural reset in our domestic lounge business.

items.statement: FY26 adjusted EBITDA INR 25.0 crores vs INR 102.1 crores in FY25
items.quote: Adjusted EBITDA for FY26 stood at INR 25.0 crores against INR 102.1 crores last year

items.statement: Q4 FY26 revenue INR 52.6 crores, gross profit negative INR 6.1 crores, adjusted EBITDA negative INR 13.4 crores, PAT negative INR 13.0 crores
items.quote: For Q4 FY26, we reported revenue of INR 52.6 crores, with Gross Profit at negative INR 6.1 crores. While Adjusted EBITDA and Profit After Tax came in at negative INR 13.4 crores and negative INR 13.0 crores, respectively.

items.statement: Significant collections post 31st March reduced receivables from INR 130 crores as of 31st December
items.quote: However, post 31st March, we have done significant collections and that number currently stands reduced to a large extent.

items.statement: Cash and cash equivalents INR 150 crores as of 31st March 2026
items.quote: We closed the year with cash and cash equivalents of INR 150 crores, providing meaningful financial flexibility to fund our growth priorities without compromising financial discipline.

items.statement: Net worth INR 313.8 crores as of 31st March 2026, up 4.3% year-on-year
items.quote: Our Net Worth as of 31st March 2026 stands at INR 313.8 crores — up 4.3% compared to the same period last year.

items.statement: Railway lounge footprint expanded to Chennai, Mumbai, Vadodara operational; Lucknow expected soon; target 50 lounges for scale
items.quote: We now have expanded our railway lounge footprint across key locations including Chennai, Mumbai and Vadodara which are already operational, while Lucknow is expected to commence operations soon, positioning the Company to capitalize on India's ongoing railway modernization and premium travel growth.

items.statement: Railway lounge revenue target INR 500 crores in 5 years remains intact
items.quote: So yes, our plan of INR500 crores 5 years remains clear intact, and we are growing significantly in Railways as well.

items.statement: Wellness tourism in India projected to grow from $31 billion to $43.7 billion by 2031 at 7.2% CAGR
items.quote: The wellness tourism in India is set to scale from nearly $31 billion this year to over $43.7 billion by 2031 at a 7.2% CAGR.

items.statement: Recognized as Great Place to Work for second year in a row; two managers received Great Manager to Work With certification
items.quote: Adding to these achievements, DreamFolks has also been recognized as a ‘Great Place to Work’ for second year in a row - a testament further bolstered by two of our managers receiving the prestigious "Great Mana ger to Work With" certification

items.statement: FY27 is a transition year due to structural changes in domestic credit card ecosystem and global network onboarding
items.quote: So for FY '27, I will be very upfront that it's a transition time right now for us. And we are working in terms of the complete industry change right now in the India market. And global, as we told you that we are still onboarding more lounges in terms of creating the network.

items.statement: India railway lounge market far from saturation compared to China and Russia; F&B companies entering the space
items.quote: If I were to do a parallel as compared to what China has in terms of total railway lounges or for that matter, Russia has, we are nowhere closer to that. Plus if you were to look at it, the -- I think you would have read in the newspaper, the macros remain very positive, bullish. A lot of F&B companies are wanting to get into this, and we want to ride on that wave.

items.statement: B2C DreamFolks Club 2.0 launched 5-6 months ago with encouraging numbers but cautious investment approach
items.quote: Yes. See, B2C, we have always been a B2B player. And you can very well imagine the kind of investment and effort that is required to get into B2C. So we have just started. So we started almost 5, 6 months back. And we are seeing very encouraging number. We are being very, very careful.

items.statement: Global expansion focus on Middle East and Southeast Asia; onboarded clients in Southeast Asia, work ongoing in Middle East
items.quote: And yes, we have onboarded clients in Southeast Asia. And parallely, there is a lot of work going on in Middle East market as well.

items.statement: Investments in platform, people, partnerships, and geographies to support global scaling and lifestyle services adoption
items.quote: We remain confident that the investments we have made in platform, people, partnerships, and geographies will translate into meaningful value creation as industry conditions normalise and our newer revenue streams gain scale.

items.statement: Consolidated revenue expected to grow ~75% over FY26 with EBITDA margin 20-20%
items.quote: In terms of the guidance for FY26-27, we expect our consolidated revenue to grow by around 75% over FY26 with EBITDA margin to be 20% to 20%.

items.statement: Inox Green FY27 EBITDA guidance upwards of INR600 crores
items.quote: With all our investments formally folding into Inox Green's ba lance sheet, along with organic growth, we maintain our FY27 EBITDA guidance to be upwards of INR600 crores

items.statement: Order book at 3.1 GW with 600 MW added in FY26; execution visibility >24 months
items.quote: Coming to the order book, we continue to have a large and very well-diversified order book of 3.1 GW, I repeat again, 3.1 GW, having added almost 600 MW in this financial year.

items.statement: Inox Clean Energy targets 14 GW capacity by FY29, adding 3+ GW annually with 20-30% wind
items.quote: Our Group Company, Inox Clean Energy, has large capacity addition plan with a targeted capacity addition of 14 GW by FY'29. It plans to add almost 3 GW plus capacity annually over the next few years.

items.statement: Order book shifting from 100% turnkey to 75-80% equipment supply over 24 months
items.quote: 24 months ago, 100% of our order book was turnkey. And over the past 24 months, we've completely turned this to now 75% to 80% being equipment supply.

items.statement: Revenue INR4,500 crores vs INR5,000 crores guidance; INR400 crores shortfall to recover in Q1-Q2
items.quote: as again st the guideline of INR5,000 crores, which we have given in the last call, we have achieved INR4,600 crores and this INR400 crores of makeover will happen in the qu arter 1, quarter 2 time scale

items.statement: Inox Green acquiring 6.5 GW operational wind O&M assets of 2 companies; NCLT approval for demerger of evacuation infra to IRSL
items.quote: This also includes the investment made to acquire 6.5 gigawatts of operational wind O&M assets of 2 companies. We expect to complete the acquisition soon, consequent to which the consolidation of financials into Inox Green will result in a multifold increase in consol EBITDA and PAT for FY27 over FY26.

items.statement: NCLT Ahmedabad approved demerger of Inox Green evacuation infrastructure into Inox Renewable Solutions; IRSL to auto-list
items.quote: The scheme of demerger of Inox Green, evacuation infrastructure business and its merger into Inox Renewable Solutions has been approved by the Honorable NCLT, Ahmedabad. IRSL will be automatically listed on the stock exchange post receipt of all the approvals.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance 20%+ for Inox Wind; Inox Green ~50% EBITDA margin on acquisitions
items.quote: We have said that we have already given the guidance in presentation also that we are looking to go only North of around 20% or higher, not below that.

items.statement: Expect 8-10 GW annual wind capacity addition driven by RTC, FDRE, hybrid; geopolitical tailwinds
items.quote: Going forward, we expect to see strong annual wind capacity addition of 8 to 10 GW over the next few years driven by RTC, FDRE and hybrid capacity additions.

items.statement: 2/3 of execution from Inox Clean and CESC, 1/3 from marquee customers; selective on external orders
items.quote: We are pivoting Inox Wind to a new avatar that would address the challenges as well as put us on a path for a major transformation that 2/3 of the annual execution for the next 4 to 5 years will be from Inox Clean and CESC, and the remaining 1/3 from other marquee customers.

items.statement: Inox Green has tax shield up to INR700 crores losses; no finance cost, depreciation eliminated post demerger
items.quote: Out of INR600 crore fees, broadly everything will be converted into the operating cash flow. As such, there will be no depreciation, no finance cost, and we have a tax shield up to INR700 crore of losses.

items.statement: Vayuveer program generating 600 skilled professionals annually; hiring Agniveers
items.quote: As part of the people strategy, our Vayuveer program at Inox Learning Academy, currently, we are generating almost highly skilled team of professionals of 600 annually to fuel our growth.

items.statement: Dividend policy for Inox Green to be decided by Board after consolidation of acquisitions
items.quote: Let the consolidation of the two companies happen. Once that happens, I'm sure the Board in all its wisdom will put in place a dividend policy.

items.statement: Geopolitical issues caused logistics challenges, ECS supply delays, PSU payment delays; force majeure impacted FY26 revenue
items.quote: Even when we shifted over to a revenue guidance and guided for INR5,000 crores in the last quarter, it was subject to force majeure. I don't think you or I would have known there would be a world war kind of a situation where ships don't come in, where ports don't clear materials, where customers hold back payments.

items.statement: Inox Clean fastest to 2 GW installed capacity, 6 GW solar module, 3 GW cell manufacturing; 10 GW IPP, 10 GW cell, 10 GW module in 15 months
items.quote: The group's strategic foray into renewable IPP power generation and solar cell and module manufacturing under Inox Clean with a three-continent play is a big game changer and expected to create huge value across the group with our 10^3 GW portfolio: basically 10 GW of IPP, 10 GW of solar cell and 10 GW of solar module over the next 15 months.

items.statement: Equipment supply on LC terms gives cash flow upfront; steel prices passed on; avoids EPC cost overruns
items.quote: equipment supply is a very f irm kind of those things. You have today a lot of control with the steel prices being passed on many of those things. And at the same time, these are very simple on LC terms mostly so that you get the cash flow up

items.statement: Medium-term export target of 20-25% of overall revenue
items.quote: Export contribution increased significantly, crossing 20% in Q2 FY '26, while the company continues to maintain a medium-term target of 20% to 25% export contribution to overall revenues.

items.statement: New component programs expected to contribute ~INR100 cr annual revenue with >1 million parts annually
items.quote: In addition, the newly secured component programs are expected to contribute annual revenues nearing INR100 crores with volumes exceeding 1 million parts annually.

items.statement: Board approved incorporation of wholly owned US subsidiary with initial INR3 cr investment
items.quote: Our Board has approved the incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary in the United States to strengthen customer proximity and deepen our engagement in the strategically important North American market.

items.statement: Transfer Case volumes grew ~70-80% to 52,000 units in FY26 from low 30s in FY25
items.quote: This year we have accomplished about 50,000, 52,000? Sudhir Mirjankar: 52,000. Jitendra Divgi: Which was up from low 30s that we did in FY '25. So you can see it's almost like 70%, 80% increase in volumes of Transfer Cases

items.statement: EV transmission capacity utilization at 25-30%, expected to improve with new model launches
items.quote: Yes, we are just -- we're still around 25% capacity utilization. Karan Gupta: 35%? Jitendra Divgi: 25% to 30

items.statement: FY26 EBITDA margin at 24.6%, Q4 FY26 at 24.5%
items.quote: EBITDA margin for the period stood at 24.6%.

items.statement: EV transmission portfolio spans 10kW to 150kW, proprietary designs enabling overseas expansion
items.quote: In conclusion, I wish to state that we have the world's widest portfolio of production -ready transmission models all the way from 10 kilowatt to 150 kilowatt.

items.statement: Secured Transfer Case orders for Mahindra Scorpio pickup and Tata Yodha pickup for Indonesia export programs as exclusive supplier
items.quote: As part of the Indonesia export programs, the company has secured Transfer Case orders for Mahindra's Scorpio pickup and Tata Motors' Yodha pickup platforms, where Divgi has been selected as the exclusive Transfer Case supplier.

items.statement: Received nomination from leading Japanese OEM for global pickup truck platform with SOP targeted FY28-29
items.quote: A key strategic mile stone during the year was the nomination received from a leading Japanese OEM for the development of transfer cases for an iconic global pickup truck platform from this OEM with SOP targeted in FY '28 -- '28-'29.

items.statement: Export revenue share reached 18% in FY26, up from ~6% in FY25
items.quote: Exports increased sharply from around 6% of revenue to a meaningful double-digit contribution of nearly 18%.

items.statement: Expect EV volumes to nearly double in FY27 with new model production starting by July
items.quote: But the vehicle testing, I think, took longer than we had thought it would. So next month or definitely by July, this new model will be going into production, and we are expecting almost a doubling of the EV volumes.

items.statement: Indonesia Transfer Case orders on track for FY27 execution
items.quote: No, it is on track for FY '27.

items.statement: Preference for organic growth in US, not pursuing inorganic opportunities currently
items.quote: Right now, our preference is to grow. Given the size of the business and the way we work, our preference is to sort of do this organically.

items.statement: Indian OEMs beat Japanese and Chinese competitors in Indonesian government tender for 70,000 Transfer Cases
items.quote: It has been won fair and square in a competitive tender that included at least 3 or 4 major Japanese OEMs, and I might add, 2 very large Chinese companies.

items.statement: Potential India-US and India-EU trade agreements could strengthen positioning as manufacturing hub
items.quote: We are also seeing encouraging opportunities emerging from global supply chain diversification initiatives and potential India-U.S. and India-EU trade agreements, which would further strengthen our positioning as a preferred manufacturing and engineering hub.

items.statement: Company remains debt-free with healthy net cash position expected to be maintained despite growth investments
items.quote: Even after factoring in future expansion plans and increased working capital requirements associated with growth, the company expects to maintain a healthy net cash position.

items.statement: Board recommended final dividend of INR3.27 per equity share (face value INR5) for FY26
items.quote: The Board of Directors has recommended a final dividend of INR3.27 per equity share of INR5 each for FY '26, subject to shareholders' approval.

items.statement: Automatic transmission technology transfer talks in advanced stages, proof-of-concept demo targeted next quarter
items.quote: Over the next quarter or so, we are trying to conclude proof-of-concept demonstration of the proposed technology on one of the latest successful vehicle platforms of our Indian OEM and work is underway in right earnest with that OEM.

items.statement: Manual transmission line designed flexibly for 2 models, high-volume model potential 60,000-100,000 units/year
items.quote: The line is being designed in a flexible way to handle 2 models. One is a low-volume model and the other one is high volume, and the high volume could be anywhere from 60,000 to 100,000.

items.statement: Potential revenue opportunity of ~INR300 cr from 4-wheel drive, ~INR1,000 cr from automatic transmission (80k-100k units/yr)
items.quote: The automatic transmission number is extremely conservative. That is about -- the number we put up there is for about 80,000 to 100,000 per year.

items.statement: EV market highly competitive with Mahindra using multinational Tier 1, MG Motors with Windsor model
items.quote: We have to remember that there is Mahindra also in this. And the Mahindra strategy is different because there's a multinational Tier 1 who is the premier supplier there. There's also MG Motors with the Windsor model.

items.statement: Export revenue grew nearly 10x, monthly run rate increased from ~INR7 cr to INR10-12 cr
items.quote: Reflecting the strong momentum in the business, our monthly revenue run rate has already increased from approximately INR7 crores to nearly INR10 crores to INR12 crores.

items.statement: Developed next-gen Torque-On-Demand Transfer Case with M-Lock technology for Mahindra platforms
items.quote: The company achieved a significant technology breakthrough with its anchor customer, that is Mahindra, through the successful development of a next -generation Torque-On-Demand Transfer Case integrated with what is known as M-Lock technology for upcoming vehicle platforms.

items.statement: Deepening engagement with global Tier 1s BorgWarner and Magna across multiple plants
items.quote: Increased volume, a deeper engagement with global Tier 1 customers such as BorgWarner and Magna, expanding customer relationships across many of their plants.

items.statement: Components segment revenue grew 124% YoY in FY26, largely export-led
items.quote: The Components segment continued its robust performance, growing 124% in FY '26 compared to FY '25. This exceptional growth was largely export -led despite global market uncertainties.

items.statement: Expect positive momentum to continue in coming quarters based on current visibility and pipeline
items.quote: With the visibility we c urrently have and the opportunities in the pipeline, we expect this positive momentum to continue in the coming quarters as well

items.statement: Management targets INR 10,000 crore revenue in FY27 and is working to achieve it before the deadline
items.quote: We are working very hard to achieve this target as soon as possible before the target deadline, what we have said. And we hope we will achieve it very soon, and it will give us immense pleasure, to all our stakeholders, our team that we will be entering into the INR 1 billion organization.

items.statement: Strong demand witnessed across major business verticals from both existing and new international buyers
items.quote: We continue to witness heavier demand across our major business vertical during the year. The company saw increase in the demand from both, existing customer and the new international buyer.

items.statement: Standalone EBITDA margin improved to 3.12% in FY26 from 2.4% in FY25 driven by operating leverage and cost control
items.quote: The EBITDA margin improved to 3.12% during the FY2526, as compared to approximately 2.4% in FY2425. The improvement in the margin reflect the benefit of operating leverage, better preserving efficiency, and tighter control over the operational cost.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved to 4.11% in FY26 from 3.57% in FY25 driven by capacity utilization, pricing and product mix
items.quote: The EBITDA margin improved to approximately 4.11% during the current year as compared to approximately 3.57% of last year.

items.statement: Malaysian authority approval received for a subsidiary enabling capacity utilization and order fulfillment
items.quote: In this year we have achieved the Malaysian authority's approval for one of our subsidies. That has made us to utilize our capacity for that plant and achieve good financial demand, and solve them on time with our utilization capacity.

items.statement: Company is working on adding French fries and chicken to product portfolio but at very initial stage with no volumes or numbers yet
items.quote: We are working on learning product, and we are also thinking to add French fries to our market. But it is very initial stage, very initial. I will not be able to comment any volumes or any numbers, but we are hoping that this is a same generic where we have a same clientele, and we feel that the same clientele can bring us a entry ticket for the same sector, so we are working on it.

items.statement: Export prices competitive vs peers in Southeast Asia; domestic peer prices higher due to livestock dependency on imports
items.quote: In Vietnam, Malaysia, you are talking about the Southeast Asia region. Their domestic prices are still higher, because they don't have a livestock availability. Their dependencies are more on that imported product. So, till now the prices are working very well, whatever we are offering them, and we hope the prices is going to share with them from India.

items.statement: Input cost inflation driven by weather, transportation costs, seasonal harvesting and farmer pricing power
items.quote: It's weather also, because if we have bad weather condition, we have some very hot summer, it's really hard for the supplier to give any transportation, because they are worried about the health of their livestock. So they need to load their livestock accordingly. Like before, if there is a capacity of any kind, we used to go in for half, and then to meet the traveling, the cost has been increased

items.statement: Geopolitical tensions in Middle East increasing freight costs multiple folds, pressuring product pricing
items.quote: If this geopolitical situation does not normalized, sooner it will really give us very bad rate on our product pricing. Because the prices from the shipping line or the transportation charges has been increasing as a big number in multiple folds.

items.statement: Rice business growing steadily with repeat orders but small contribution; building food basket for clients
items.quote: We are working very fine with the rice business, and we have a good clientele now. We are getting repeat orders from the rice business also. But as we all know, the right commodity, we have many other jobs available. So rice business in India depends on the pricing also. But we work very closely with all our clients, and we are retaining the clients and, slowly, slowly, but steadily we have a grow

items.statement: OFS conducted at INR 18 floor price decided by board based on SEBI circular and market value to achieve minimum public shareholding
items.quote: Basically, it was decided on the basis of current market value price. Floor price, the board decided. The floor price, which was decided by the board , because w e have achieved the minimum public shareholding by way of stock exchange mechanism , through a window, separate window , okay. So the lower price was decided by the management. It is the selling

items.statement: Standalone revenue grew 39.2% YoY to INR 67,689 million in FY26
items.quote: If we talk about the revenue, our stand-alone revenue for the financial year 2025, '26 increased to INR 67,689 million as compared to INR 48,640 million in the last financial year, register a strong growth of approximately 39.2% YoY.

items.statement: Standalone EBITDA grew 80.3% YoY to INR 2,109.5 million in FY26
items.quote: If I share the EBITDA with you, the stand-alone EBITDA grows significantly to INR 2,109.5 million during the FY2526, as compared to INR 1,170.2 million in last year, r eflecting an impressive growth of approximately 80.3% YoY

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA grew to INR 2,839.59 million in FY26 from INR 1,834.9 million in FY25
items.quote: Consolidated EBITDA is INR 2,839.59 million as compared to INR 1,834.9 million last year.

items.statement: Freight cost escalation from Middle East conflict could severely pressure product pricing across all commodities
items.quote: the prices for freight is further going to increase, it will definitely bring strong pressure on our product. Not only our product, all the store commodities

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth guidance of 18-20% with EBITDA margin of 7.5-7.8% and PAT margin of 4-4.5%
items.quote: But our focus of 18% to 20% growth for the whole year , and working on an EBITDA of about 7.5% on average and a PAT between 4% to 4.5%, that will be the kind of guidance with which we will continue to look at the future.

items.statement: Plan to open 18-20 stores in FY27 with franchise-led expansion focus
items.quote: 18 to 20 stores is what we would like to open. And the focus for our team is on how we can open more and more franchisees because that will enable our scalability

items.statement: Old gold exchange reached ~50% of Q4 FY26 revenue and ~44% for full FY26
items.quote: In the last year itself, we have seen that old gold exchange as a proportion of our overall transactions has gone up to ~44% of total revenue for FY 26 and ~50% for Q4 FY26.

items.statement: Old gold exchange expected to remain at 50-55% of business going forward with minimal margin impact
items.quote: I think that old gold exchange is a minimum 50% of the overall business to move ahead from that , what we are seeing should be something that should be a benchmark , and we should work towards getting it. There are possibilities of increasing it further, maybe from 50% to 55%.

items.statement: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin at 13.7% and full year at 11.5%, above earlier guidance of 7.5-7.8% due to gold price rise and product mix improvement
items.quote: In fact, gross margin and EBITDA were higher than our earlier guidance of 7.5% to 7.8% for the quarter as well as for the whole year, as we have explained earlier that this is due to the price rise in gold and silver and a part of it is due to the improvement in the product mix

items.statement: Sustainable EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 7.5-7.8% despite operating leverage due to competitive intensity
items.quote: So, prima facie, we are not looking at any substantial, I would say, substantial improvement in margin year-on-year despite operating leverage at full play. And let's say, 10 to 15 bps max, we are looking at as the competition will continue to intensify.

items.statement: Sennes brand (lab-grown diamonds & lifestyle) has 12 exclusive stores and is EBITDA-positive in second year
items.quote: Just to complement. So, while we have 12 exclusive Sennes stores, we are also selling Sennes products from Senco stores, excluding the lab-grown diamond. If I look at the Sennes business as a whole, at the EBITDA level, it is positive.

items.statement: Plan to increase factory manufacturing from current 4-5% to 10% of total manufacturing over time
items.quote: We want to take the factory manufacturing to 10%. Let's say, if I'm selling today 5% of INR8,000 crores, that is INR400 crores. When it becomes INR20,000 crores, 10%, it will become INR2,000 crores.

items.statement: Entered new geographies: Rajasthan (Bikaner), Western UP, Nagpur (Maharashtra) via franchise route
items.quote: We have grown last year into the newer markets. We have gone into Rajasthan (Bikaner) through the franchise route. So that's opened an immense opportunity. In Madhya Pradesh, we have a franchisee. In Maharashtra, Nagpur, we have launched.

items.statement: FY27 store opening pipeline skewed towards Bihar and UP
items.quote: But we have a very strong pipeline for FY27, which is skewed towards Bihar and UP.

items.statement: Customs duty hike from 6% to 15% expected to yield inventory gains of ~9% on gold inventory value (~INR4,500 crores) flowing through Q1-Q2 FY27
items.quote: 9% on the gold value of INR4,500 crores, you can assume INR450 Senco Gold Limited Q4 FY26 Earnings Call, Dated- May 27, 2026 crores or INR400 crores, but it is not that simple. So, from a rough out-of-the-envelope calculation, it will be 9% of INR4,500

items.statement: Hedging ratio maintained at 40-50% to balance risk and liquidity, with policy to hedge up to 80%
items.quote: We've kept a steady mind and a steady head and kept our hedging ratio at about 40% to 50% to balance between all kinds of risk.

items.statement: 9-carat and 14-carat jewellery now 13-15% of total sales (including diamond), launched immediately after government hallmarking approval
items.quote: As of today, I would say that though it won't be the exact figure, I would say anything between 15% to 20%, 15% for sure, which will be lower. If you look at diamond jewel lery, gold, and everything put together, it will be around 13%- 15% approximately

items.statement: Diamond jewellery value growth 32% YoY and volume growth 9% YoY in FY26
items.quote: We've seen a 32% value growth in the diamond jewellery sales also. So, it is not only that people are exchanging old gold for new gold, but we are also encouraging how they can exchange their old gold to buy diamonds.

items.statement: Average ticket size grew ~30% YoY in FY26
items.quote: So, our ATV, if you look at it, our average ticket size has grown by almost 30% YoY. So, consumers using either the money that they have or the old gold that they have, they are buying the jewellery based on their budget.

items.statement: Existing customer reactivation through schemes and offers contributed to growth alongside new customer acquisition
items.quote: We have worked on how to make our old dormant customers active through our various schemes, offers, and that has something that has worked for us in Q3 , where we had a phenomenal performance for our festive season for Dhanteras

items.statement: Inventory days increased to 186-188 days in FY26 due to gold price rise, new store inventory, and pre-election/Akshaya Tritiya buildup; target 160-180 days
items.quote: Inventory days have increased to 186 days. Two reasons can be stated. As you said, our inventory always builds up during September and March. These are the 2 primary reasons. An extra reason is that for us in the East, Poila Boishakh is one of the most important festivals.

items.statement: GML (Gold Metal Loan) declined in Q4 due to cash flow mismatch from March gold price spike; intent to restore to 50%+ as borrowing cost is 3-3.5%
items.quote: So, GML, Pallavi ji, it declined because of the huge gold price rise, which happened in March. You are aware that in the month of March, the fee went up to almost 180,000, right? At that moment in time, there was a cash flow mismatch, and a lot of positions had to be squared up due to the hedging position taken through GML.

items.statement: Credit rating upgraded one notch by ClearEdge; ICRA renewal pending with expected improvement given ROE 25%, ROCE 22%, interest coverage 4.5x
items.quote: One good thing that I must highlight is that our rating has been upgraded 1 notch by ClearEdge, and the rating renewal is pending with ICRA. And with the improved financials and improved interest coverage ratio of 4.5% and the return on equity of 20% northwards

items.statement: Proposed final dividend of 20% in addition to 15% interim dividend already announced
items.quote: We are also extremely happy to discuss with the Board and propose a final dividend of 20% in addition to the earlier interim dividend of 15% that we had announced.

items.statement: Actively promoting old gold exchange aligned with PM's appeal to rationalise gold imports and promote recycled gold
items.quote: Currently, if you have seen our honourable Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi ji, talking about how we need to make sure that we promote the old gold exchange. We promote ways and means by which the consumption of imported gold can be reduced.

items.statement: Flagged risk of customs duty reversal (15% to 6%) causing inventory losses; difficult to fully hedge via MCX due to 25-26% margins
items.quote: So, in the GML, even in the current year, we will continue to pay customs duty at 15%. That means that risk is uncovered. So, if my 100 kg of inventory is there and if I have purchased 50% through GML, I would have paid the customs duty, which means that I have to take 150% hedging to cover the risk of a gold price rise.

items.statement: Near-term demand softness in May due to PM's old gold appeal and Adhik Maas (inauspicious period); footfalls down in last 7-10 days
items.quote: In May, after the announcement, there has been a little bit of a slowdown. But again, at the same time, for the whole year, we will continue to remain positive. This time, it is Adhik Maas going on, which is an inauspicious season to buy gold.

items.statement: Akshaya Tritiya (April 2026) primary sales ~INR1,500 crores with 67% growth; West Bengal +69%, East Bengal +78%, North Bengal +75%, Northeast +64%, Central +162%
items.quote: In April, during the Akshaya Tritiya and Poila Boishakh, we grew by 67% , and we achieved very high sales. I'm saying at the primary level of around INR1,500 crores.

items.statement: April 2026 revenue growth 40-50% YoY; May YTD performance broadly similar to May 2025
items.quote: I must tell all of you that in the month of April, we saw very strong and rob ust growth compared to last year’s April, of close to 40% to 50%. In May, after the announcement, there has been a little bit of a slowdown

items.statement: Marketing spend to continue at 1.8-2.2% of revenue for brand building and new category growth
items.quote: No, I think that the marketing expense is 1.8% to 2.2%, we will continue at that kind of thing that we will invest for the future. 1.8% is something that will be needed for future growth.

items.statement: Free cash flow remains negative due to inventory expansion and gold price rise; unable to guide positive FCF in near term
items.quote: While we are cognizant , when we see the free cash flow of others, at least we are not able to give guidance on this that will become positive in the next 1 or 2 years.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance range of 16% to 19% for FY27
items.quote: So, the EBITDA margin has gone up, and we are taking a very safe route of saying it should always be in the 16% to 19% range, because there are various swing factors.

items.statement: Inventory days target of 120-150 days
items.quote: Anywhere between 120 days to 150 days.

items.statement: Plan to add 200-250 stores in FY27 with 25-35% COCO mix
items.quote: We are planning to add almost 200 to 250 stores. Having said that, the square feet of the store would be around 500 to 1,500 square feet.

items.statement: Target 65-70% revenue from retail (offline) channel
items.quote: But still, we would always want 65% to 70% of our business to come from retail. That's what we would always want.

items.statement: Underlying demand for branded footwear and apparel intact, driven by Tier 2/3 shift to organized retail
items.quote: The Indian consumer, especially in Tier 2 and Tier 3 towns where the majority of our stores sit, is making a clear and steady shift towards organized branded product.

items.statement: GST reduction on footwear below INR2,500 acted as volume catalyst
items.quote: The GST reduction on footwear below INR2,500 was a meaningful volume catalyst for us, specifically because nearly all of our products sit in that bracket.

items.statement: FY26 EBITDA margin expanded to 19% from 17.5% in FY25 on operating leverage and cost efficiency
items.quote: Our EBITDA margins expanded from 17.5% in FY25 to 19% in FY26, and this was on the back of operating leverage and cost efficiency measures.

items.statement: Gross margin compression due to e-commerce rebate accounting change, no impact on PBT
items.quote: So, the gross margin, you can see the shrinkage came because of the top-line, and not basically because anything we had done differently this year.

items.statement: FY26 revenue INR2,415 crores, up 19.6% YoY; Q4 revenue INR674 crores
items.quote: Moving to the full year, revenue came at INR2,415 crores, a growth of 19.6% over FY25.

items.statement: Footwear INR1,535 crores (63%), Apparel INR805 crores (34%), Accessories INR75 crores (3%) in FY26
items.quote: Footwear has achieved a number of INR1,535 crores. This is the anchor of the portfolio and it has continued to grow at a strong pace.

items.statement: Same-store sales growth 17.8% in Q4 FY26
items.quote: Our SSSG, which is the same-store sales growth was 17.8% in Q4.

items.statement: Capex spent on warehouse expansion (Ludhiana new, Unnao +3 lakh sq ft) and retail expansion
items.quote: We have expanded our warehouse capabilities. We have opened one new marketplace warehouse. In the last financial year, we opened Ludhiana. We also expanded our existing warehouse by almost 3 lakhs square feet in Unnao, and the rest is all the retail expansion.

items.statement: 223 exclusive showrooms across 161 cities at end FY26; 550+ stores currently
items.quote: On our network, we ended the year with 223 exclusive showrooms across 161 cities.

items.statement: 7 marketplace warehouses currently, planning 2 more
items.quote: We have seven warehouses across India, and we plan to open two more.

items.statement: No MRP increases planned for next 3-6 months; POs locked 6 months ahead
items.quote: As of today, we are not increasing any MRPs or nothing. We are doing nothing of that sort.

items.statement: Apparel investment focus for FY27; accessories growing fastest at 3% revenue share
items.quote: This is the segment we are most actively investing for FY27 also.

items.statement: Launched Ozark (outdoor), Bond Street and Mode (occasion/formal) brands in FY26
items.quote: We have built a new brand name Ozark. It is a rugged, outdoor and adventure brand and it has been getting better than anticipated response.

items.statement: Online repeat customer rate 54-58% on marketplaces; offline believed 4-month footwear, 5-6 month apparel repeat cycles
items.quote: With respect to online, the repeat customer for us is as high as almost 55%, 58%, but it varies for every portal.

items.statement: Channel mix: ~70% offline retail, ~30% online (marketplace model via Flipkart, Myntra)
items.quote: So, our retail stores, which we term as the offline business, it contributes almost 70%, close to 70%, and 30% of the turnover comes from our online business.

items.statement: Inventory days reduced from 250+ to ~170, targeting 150 days; payable days dropped significantly
items.quote: If you have watched our company for the last couple of years, it has come down from almost 250 days to 170 days right now.

items.statement: Debt reduced by INR200 crores from September to March; operating cash flow INR175 crores
items.quote: If you can see, debt outstanding has considerably gone down by INR200 crores, if you can see, from the September to March now.

items.statement: Board recommended final dividend INR2 per equity share (face value INR2)
items.quote: We are pleased to announce that the Board has recommended a final INR2 per equity share on the face value of INR2.

items.statement: Transition from family-run to professionally managed organization; younger generation taking leadership roles
items.quote: Ultimately, we are moving from a family-run business to a professionally managed organization. I think that's where we, as a young blood, come in and do more of talking and doing business.

items.statement: Number two footwear brand on Flipkart and Myntra for last couple of years
items.quote: We are the number two footwear brand on Flipkart and Myntra.

items.statement: Raw material price volatility risk post-September; monitoring closely
items.quote: Post-September it will be a better time to judge it. As of today, we are not increasing any MRPs or nothing.

items.statement: Anticipates margins to remain healthy in coming quarters.
items.quote: So we have been working hard to increase the profitability year-on-year, and we anticipate margins to remain healthy in the quarters to come.

items.statement: Working on detailed capacity expansion plan for Taloja; capex budget clarity in subsequent quarters.
items.quote: Having said that, we are working on a detailed plan in terms of what is the capacity expansion plan for the next 2 years. Maybe in the subsequent quarters, there will be more clarity that will be emerged in terms of the capex budget plan in the Taloja facility.

items.statement: Capex plans for India to be drawn up in next 2-3 quarters; Sharjah has spare capacity.
items.quote: And like Aslesh bhai explained to some of the gentlemen earlier, we will shortly be drawing up our capex plans in the next 2 to 3 quarters, and we shall let you all know about that.

items.statement: Board approved broad investment for South Africa; no investment planned yet, details to follow.
items.quote: We have just taken a broad approval from the Board for investment of the amount that we discussed. And we will soon get back to you with the detailed action plan in terms of our South Africa business.

items.statement: Passed on price rises to customers; pass-through contracts for 35-40% of customers, rest spot pricing.
items.quote: And we have passed through contracts with about 35%, 40% of our customers. And for the rest also, we have been revising our prices to to pass on all these price rises.

items.statement: Base oil prices rose 20-25% vs crude 10%; index-linked buying and sales provide pass-through.
items.quote: I mean, although the crude oil prices must have increased, say, by, say, 10%, but the base oil prices have increased by, say, 20%, 25%.

items.statement: Expects historical double-digit volume growth to continue.
items.quote: Volume-wise also, we have historically had volume growth in the range of 10% also every year. So we expect the volume growth also to be there.

items.statement: PHPO segment expected to grow at around 4% CAGR over next 4-5 years; remains company forte.
items.quote: We concentrate on the PHPO part of our business, where the growth is around 4% CAGR for the next 4, 5 years, and that remains our forte, and we expect to stay in that.

items.statement: Segmental mix: PHPO ~50%, lubricants 27%, PIO 10.19%.
items.quote: Our segmental mix remains well diversified with PHPO contributing approximately 50%, lubricants 27% and PIO 10.19%.

items.statement: Strait of Hormuz disruption impacted Texol plant; situation normalizing in last 15 days.
items.quote: But having said that, since last 15 days, the situation has normalized a little bit.

items.statement: Around 20-22% of raw material from Middle East; diversifying to Korean and domestic suppliers.
items.quote: So currently, around 20%, 22% of the total raw material is primarily coming from the Middle East suppliers. And obviously, we have tweaked our strategy. We've been focusing on buying more raw material from our Korean suppliers.

items.statement: Open to inorganic growth opportunities if something works out.
items.quote: Yes, we're open to inorganic growth opportunities. If something works out, we are open to it.

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth guidance of 23% YoY excluding new acquisitions with 5% EBITDA margin
items.quote: We aim for consolidated revenue growth of 23% year-on-year, excluding any new acquisitions with 5% EBITDA margins.

items.statement: EBITDA to operating cash flow conversion ratio target of at least 50% for FY27
items.quote: We aim to deliver EBITDA to operating cash flow conversion ratio to be at least 50% to ensure sustainable growth path for future.

items.statement: Minority interest expected at 25-27% of PAT before minority interest in FY27, down from 38% in Q4 FY26
items.quote: So what we can say for next year, you can take around 25% to 27% of PAT before minority interest to be contribution from minority interest.

items.statement: Tax rate expected in range of 22-23% for FY27
items.quote: So we expect it to be in the range of about 22% - 23% for FY '27.

items.statement: FY26 EBITDA margin of 4% achieved, up 67 bps YoY; Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin 4.5%, up 85 bps YoY
items.quote: Again, I'm pleased to share that we delivered 4% EBITDA margin, which is +67 basis points year-on-year with EBITDA at INR266 crores.

items.statement: Gross margin expanded 78 bps YoY to 10.3% in FY26; Q4 gross margin 10.9%, up 110 bps YoY
items.quote: This came on the back of gross margin expansion of 78 basis points year-on-year to 10.3%, driven by better product mix and procurement efficiencies.

items.statement: Gross margin improvement driven by scale-led procurement economies and commercial role for manufacturers
items.quote: So why we are able to get a better margin just because of our scale. Once you buy so much in those quantities, of course, you can enjoy economics of purchasing, right.

items.statement: Commercial role contributes >10-15% of sales with at least double normal distribution margins
items.quote: So I would say in more than 10% to 15% of our sales is coming from where we are playing a full commercial role.

items.statement: MedTech segment contributes >INR1,000 crores annualized revenue after 7 acquisitions including 3 in MedTech
items.quote: The segment now contributes more than INR1,000 crores in annualized revenue for us.

items.statement: MedTech revenue share >15% currently, aspiring to reach 20% in 2-3 years
items.quote: So on revenue side, the MedTech contribution now given all the acquisition that we have done and now everything we have consolidated in our revenues, it will be more than 15%.

items.statement: Organic like-for-like growth of 15.6% in FY26, outperforming IPM by 1.6x; Q4 organic growth 17.1%
items.quote: We outperformed IPM by 1.6x, delivering an organic like-for-like growth of 15.6%.

items.statement: GLP-1 sales at INR10-12 crores/month (~5% of industry GLP value), built into growth guidance
items.quote: So GLP-1, as we said, at the end of the day, see, we are doing approximately INR10 crores to INR12 crores of GLP sales per month, okay.

items.statement: Depreciation increased 50% sequentially due to MedTech IVD reagent rental model assets placed at customer sites
items.quote: The depreciation has increased because in the MedTech business is slightly different from your typical pharma distribution business where there will be assets that will be placed at customer levels as well.

items.statement: Net working capital days improved to 59 days in Q4 FY26 from 64 days in Q3 FY26; operating cash flow INR104.6 crores in Q4
items.quote: We achieved operating cash flow of INR104.6 crores with net working capital days at 59 days versus 64 days in the previous quarter.

items.statement: Higher payable days driven by MedTech payment cycles; incremental working capital needs minimal as Q4 balance sheet already reflects annualized revenue base
items.quote: So the payables increase is mainly contributed by higher MedTech contribution. MedTech, the payment cycle is not like 7 and 21 days as in pharma.

items.statement: Finance cost expected to remain stable near-term then decline over next couple of years as IPO funds deployed and acquisition debt repaid
items.quote: So we expect finance cost to remain relatively stable and then come down in future. So because in the earlier years, we had the IPO funds, which were also parked pending investment into acquisitions.

items.statement: 7 acquisitions closed in FY26 including 3 in MedTech; no new acquisitions factored into FY27 guidance; focus on organic growth for next 6-8 months
items.quote: If you look at my next year guidance, I've given a guidance without including any new acquisitions, right? So we have done a lot of M&A in the last 1 or 2 years.

items.statement: Acquisition valuations at 5-7x EV/EBITDA; call options for full ownership at predetermined timelines (3-5 years)
items.quote: The same that we have always said before, which is 5 to 7x of enterprise value to EBITDA.

items.statement: 100% of recent acquisition management teams retained; promoters stay minimum 1 year post-acquisition with skin in the game
items.quote: 100% of the acquisition. The recent acquisition we are talking about?

items.statement: ROCE improved to 14.6% in FY26 from 10.7% in FY25; Q4 ROCE 18.4%, targeting >20% in FY27
items.quote: Return on capital employed improved to 14.6% in FY '26 from 10.7% in FY '25 and return on equity increased to 12.5% from 7.7% in FY '25.

items.statement: Giving up certain low-margin businesses and net-margin revenue recognition to improve profitability and release working capital
items.quote: And also, there are certain low-margin business that we are giving up, and we are releasing the working capital to invest in more profitable or more higher return on investment generating assets.

items.statement: Platform serves >100,000 retail pharmacies (1 in 10 in India) and 3,600 hospitals across 523 districts with 97,500 SKUs from 3,300 manufacturers
items.quote: Currently, the health care supply chain industry sized over USD 33 billion is extremely fragmented, which presents a massive opportunity for consolidating the space through use of technology and scale.

items.statement: Two-way moat: 100,000 customers attract manufacturers, 3,000+ manufacturers attract customers; barrier to entry built over 7-8 years and 40-50 M&As
items.quote: So it's a 2-way moat. It's a 2-way closed-loop system. More companies come to you because we have so much of customers and more customers come to you because we have so many companies, right?

items.statement: Largely insulated from Middle East crisis as minimal direct imports; work with local subsidiaries of global partners
items.quote: Largely, we are insulated. To be honest, like if you look at the last quarter, the conflict started in end of February, our numbers for the quarter was good.

items.statement: Net worth flattish due to first-time recognition of put option liability under IndAS for partial-stake acquisitions
items.quote: This is basically the impact of the first-time recognition of put option liability. So typically, the -- that's the main reason why you're seeing the net worth flattish.

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth guidance 45-55%, EBITDA margin 16-18%, PAT margin 11%
items.value: 45-55% revenue growth; 16-18% EBITDA margin; 11% PAT margin
items.quote: We expect revenue growth of approximately 45% to 55% with EBITDA margin expected to remain in the range of 16% to 18% and PAT margins at around 11% to 11%.

items.statement: FY27 targeted order inflow ~INR2,000 crore; bid pipeline INR6,000 crore
items.value: INR2,000 crore order inflow target; INR6,000 crore bid pipeline
items.quote: Our targeted order inflow of financial '27 stands of approximately INR2,000 crore, while the current bid pipeline remains robust at INR6,000 crores, providing strong visibility for future growth.

items.statement: FY27 consolidated revenue INR1,500-1,750 crore; PAT margin 8.75-10.25%
items.quote: Yes, this year our consolidated turnover should be between INR1,500 crores to INR1,750 crore. And this PAT will be, yes, yes, PAT will be around same, 8.75% to 10.25%.

items.statement: Current consolidated order book mix: 51% slope stabilization, ~40% roads, 2% tunnels; slope projects PAN-India (Uttarakhand, Northeast), roads focused in Maharashtra
items.quote: we see the order mix also, so 51% is the total order book consolidated which is from slope stabilization. Rutu Chavan: Right. Sanjay Mehta: So, if you take road and the road will be almost 40-some percent and tunnel is 2

items.statement: Slope competitors: Spar Geo, Bharat, Pioneer, KEC; Road competitors: many (Gawar, GRIL, etc.)
items.quote: In slope, our competitors are mainly Spar Geo, Bharat, then we have Pioneer, and we have KEC. In road, you know, there are so many hundreds. You can name from Gawar to GRIL, everybody's competitor.

items.statement: Trade payables rose to INR145 cr (INR148 cr current portion) due to higher purchases/contract expenses in Q4; will be paid off in coming quarter
items.quote: increase in trade payables is purely because of trade -- the increase in operations. This trade payables does not contain anything that we've entered in acquisitions or anything like that. These are the regular day-to-day activities. And if you see, the total creditors, the total payables are of INR166 crores, but out of that, INR148 crores are the current portion. So, there will be paid off in th

items.statement: MD Puneet Pal Singh honored ET Young Industry Leader 2025; no management changes mentioned
items.quote: Our Managing Director, Mr. Puneet Pal Singh, has been honoured as a ET Young Industry Leader 2025 by Times of India Group, which further strengthens the belief which management has put on our young MD.

items.statement: No slowdown seen in government project bidding despite geopolitical concerns; HAM project lost (H2 not H1)
items.quote: As far as we are concerned, global projects are still there only and we are working on those projects in the same – with the same vigor. We don't have seen any - I have heard about slowdown, but I have not seen any slowdown in our projects so far which we are bidding

items.statement: FY27 India multi-channel growth will be much superior to FY26 due to RocketBees, Qwik, and offline initiatives
items.quote: So, FY27, we continue to believe that because of our initiatives that we will have a better growth overall for FY27 than compared to the entire FY26.

items.statement: India multi-channel EBITDA expected to grow double-digit in FY27 as manufacturing margin loss recovers by Q2 and operating leverage kicks in
items.quote: Yes, you will have it, Percy, it should. Effectively, we are saying the EBITDA, I would say the drop that we have seen because of manufacturing should be recovered fully by Q2.

items.statement: Plan to open roughly 100 company-owned and franchise stores in FY27 after pausing in FY26 for capital efficiency
items.quote: So, we will double down on our approach to open company-owned stores in FY27 and hopefully with a mix of COCO as well as FOFO stores, we should be opening roughly 100 stores in this year.

items.statement: India multi-channel GMV crossed $1 billion for the first time in FY26, growing 11% year-on-year
items.quote: for the first time, we crossed $1 billion in GMV for the India multi-channel

items.statement: India multi-channel gross margin pressure of 140 bps from diapering competition continued in Q4; manufacturing margin loss from rupee depreciation and crude-linked raw materials is transitory and will recover by Q2 FY27
items.quote: The good news would be that these are very transitional in nature. These will be passed on to the customers and the impact of the incremental gross margin loss apart from the Q3 will be regained back in quarter two as they are being passed to the customer in a regular BAU.

items.statement: Home brand mix and fashion share increasing to drive gross margin expansion in India multi-channel and international
items.quote: The levers, some of the levers, not all, but some of the levers that I want to highlight here for gross margin expansion are increase in the home brand share of top line and within home brands, also the fashion business share, 9 fashion share to the business

items.statement: International business faces moderation in consumer sentiment and import complexities due to Middle East situation, but focus remains on sustainable growth and loss reduction
items.quote: However, it has been a little bit of a moderation in consumer sentiment. I'm not going to say anything else about that, but, yes, there has been and there is some import complexities also is happening as we speak.

items.statement: 6-12 years age segment remains fastest growing part of India multi-channel business with strong long-term cohort retention
items.quote: So, we are seeing a positive traction and we continue to see a positive traction in 6 to 12 that remains the fastest growing part of our business when it comes to age group of children.

items.statement: Diapering category (15% of business) facing irrational competitive intensity from quick commerce and horizontal players for 4-6 quarters, pressuring gross margins by 140 bps
items.quote: We believe that its probably a 4-6 quarters sort of a phenomena. It'll go away. So, that's on the 140 bps that we are talking about, that we spoke in Q3, that has continued for this quarter.

items.statement: RocketBees expanded to 62 cities covering 40%+ of online delivery volumes by end Q4 FY26, ahead of 45-50% mid-year target
items.quote: Now by end of Q4, we have moved up to 62 cities and overall percentage of our online delivery volumes, we're able to deliver 40% plus by end of Q4 through our RocketBees initiative.

items.statement: Qwik quick commerce expanded to 5 cities, delivering 20%+ of online orders in covered catchments; target 10% of total B2C shipments by end FY27
items.quote: We expect over the full year of FY27, our Qwik deliveries over entire B2C shipments should cross roughly around 10% of our overall online business.

items.statement: GlobalBees core categories grew 28% YoY in FY26 with Rs 91.9 crore adjusted EBITDA (4.9% margin); brand rationalization to complete by Q1 FY27
items.quote: We did a revenue of 1876.8 Crores, which was a 28% year-on-year growth and a 91.9 Crore adjusted EBITDA post-corporate expenses, which translates to a 4.9% of revenue.

items.statement: Preschool business revenue grew 11% in FY26 with EBITDA margin improving 220 bps to 27%; store count more than doubled to 208+ in 2 years
items.quote: A healthy growth in revenue, 11% growth in revenue in FY26 over FY25 and around 220 bps improvement in the EBITDA from 24% in FY25 to 27% in FY26.

items.statement: Consolidated free cash flow positive for full year FY26; cash profit up 49% to Rs 312 crore
items.quote: Cash Profit for the entire year on a consol basis has roughly reached around 312 Crores, which is a 49% increase over the last fiscal year. Obviously, happy to report that we continue to PAT and cash flow positive in India multi-channel business and also on a free cash flow positive on a consol basis.

items.statement: RocketBees and Qwik logistics cost front-loading of 40-60 bps for few quarters until network matures, then costs normalize
items.quote: So, till then, you have to front-load, so, we will have some impact of 40 to 60 bps from few quarters, but in a medium term as the network matures, our cost will normalize to a regular sort of a cost structure that we had.

items.statement: Targets EBITDA margin of 27-28% and PAT margin of 18-19%
items.quote: EBITDA margin is expected to stabilize around 27-28%. PAT margin is expected to stabilize at around 18-19%.

items.statement: Targets 20-25% year-on-year revenue growth over next 5-6 years
items.quote: So, we expect about 20-25% growth year-on-year basis.

items.statement: Expects revenue of Rs. 1200-1300 crores in FY27
items.quote: Yes, next year should be more only because we are launching our Thane project this financial year. So, it should have a good spike in the growth rate.

items.statement: Project pipeline of Rs. 12,000 crores spread over next 5-6 years
items.quote: We have a pipeline of about Rs. 12,000 crores spread over the next 5-6 years.

items.statement: Signed MOU for cluster redevelopment of 9 societies at Ashok Nagar, Kandivali East with 3.25 lakh sq ft RERA carpet area and Rs. 1100 crores GDV
items.quote: Additionally, I am delighted to share that last evening we signed an MOU for securing the rights for cluster redevelopment of 9 societies at Ashok Nagar in Kandivali East having an estimated RERA carpet area of 3.25 lakh square feet with a GDV projected of Rs. 1100 crores.

items.statement: Filmistan project expected GDV of Rs. 3500 crores with cumulative bottom-line contribution of Rs. 1000-1200 crores over 3-5 years
items.quote: Based on current estimates and subject to final approvals and design configurations, expected GDV of the project is Rs. 3500 crores. Estimated cumulative bottom-line contribution over next 3-5 years Rs. 1000-1200 crores.

items.statement: Acquired Filmistan land for Rs. 165 crores and tenancy rights valued at Rs. 182.6 crores
items.quote: Outright acquisition of land, Arkade Developers acquired the underlying land parcel from Aspen Properties and Kamanwala Housing for a consideration of Rs. 165 crores, which was fully paid in January '25, consequently the ownership of the land now rests directly with Arkade Developers.

items.statement: FY26 EBITDA margin at 23.2%, Q4 FY26 at 19.4%
items.quote: The EBITDA margin for FY26 stood at 23.2%.

items.statement: Q4 FY26 pre-sales of Rs. 303 crores, up 40% YoY; area sold 1,10,000 sq ft, up 57% YoY
items.quote: We achieved highest-ever quarterly pre-sales of Rs. 303 crores for Q4 FY26, a growth of 40% on year-on-year basis, vis-à-vis Rs. 217 crores in Q4 FY25

items.statement: FY26 pre-sales of Rs. 901 crores, up 17% YoY; area sold 3,15,000 sq ft, up 27% YoY
items.quote: We recorded pre-sales of Rs. 901 crores for FY26, a growth of 17% on year-on-year basis, as against Rs. 773 crores in the previous corresponding year.

items.statement: May pre-sales slower due to war impact, fuel prices, and global economic situation
items.quote: Consistent only. They are a little slow because of the war impact and the fuel prices impact and the global economical situation.

items.statement: Luxury segment share in MMR climbed to 44% in 9M FY26 from 31% in FY21; properties priced 2-5 crores dominate sales
items.quote: The share of luxury segment sales in MMR has sharply climbed to 44% in the nine-month FY26, up from 31% in FY21 in terms of area sold, driven by an evolving consumer preference for larger premium homes.

items.statement: Added approx. 20% manpower in front-ending Execution and Sales team
items.quote: We have added approx. 20% manpower in our front-ending team of the Execution and Sales Department in line with our growth plan.

items.statement: Completed strategic acquisition of Filmistan Pvt. Ltd. in Goregaon West; became wholly owned subsidiary; tenancy rights merged into Arkade
items.quote: In FY26, Arkade Developers completed the strategic acquisition of Filmistan Pvt. Ltd., a marquee and high-value property located in the premium residential micro-market of Goregaon West of SV Road, Mumbai.

items.statement: Filmistan project under approval, targeting launch by financial year-end
items.quote: The project is under approval currently and we are looking at launching it by this year-end, financial year-end.

items.statement: FY26 collections of Rs. 728 crores, up 2% YoY; Q4 FY26 collections of Rs. 195 crores
items.quote: Collections for FY26 came in at Rs. 728 crores, registering a year-on-year growth of 2%, from Rs. 716 crores in FY25.

items.statement: Exceptional one-time accounting impact of Rs. 182.17 crores from write-off of Filmistan tenancy rights
items.quote: As a result of this structuring exercise, the tenancy rights recorded in Filmistan Pvt. Ltd. have been written-off, adjusted, resulting in one-time exceptional accounting impact of Rs. 182.17 crores in the consolidated financial statements for the period.

items.statement: MMR years to sell at historic low of 1.2-1.4 years indicating robust demand outstripping new launches
items.quote: The years to sell has hit a historic low, hovering around 1.2 to 1.4 years, indicating a robust year-end demand, outstripping the pace of new launches.

items.statement: 200 KLPD grain-based distillery commissioning trials targeted for next month (June 2026)
items.quote: we are targeting commissioning trials next month

items.quote: In EPC, I always say that margins are somewhere between, 9% to 11% depending on where you are in terms of raw material price cycle and this is an abnormal year currently going on because of the war.

items.statement: Order book stands at INR2,800 crores: INR1,674 crores solar EPC & O&M, INR1,136 crores BESS EPC & IPP
items.quote: My solar EPC currently stands at order book of about INR1674 crores. And BESS is close to about INR1136 crores.

items.statement: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin 12.1%, PAT margin 8.1%; FY26 EBITDA margin 13.3%, PAT margin 8.5%
items.quote: For the financial year '26, total income stood at INR1416 crores, representing year-on-year growth of 1.57%. Our EBITDA stood at INR187.9 crores and margin stood at 13.3%. Our PAT for the period was INR120.4 crores, translating into a net margin of 8.5%.

items.statement: BESS manufacturing expected PBT margins of 14-15% at full capacity
items.quote: So BESS typically has better margin profile compared to solar. So I would say somewhere between 14% to 15% is what we should expect.

items.statement: 3.4 GW BESS manufacturing facility capex INR55-60 crores; already spent, under trials
items.quote: Sir, capex is close to about INR55 crores to INR60 crores.

items.statement: 1.5 GW solar module facility operational at Roorkee; 3.4 GW BESS facility ready with trials underway; 1.2 GW solar cell facility targeted commercial operation by June 2027
items.quote: FY26 marked an important milestone in our manufacturing journey, with the commencement of the operations in our 1.5 gigawatt solar module manufacturing facility in Roorkee.

items.statement: Targeting 60-40 BESS to solar EPC revenue mix; BESS revenue expected INR800-1,000 crores in FY27 vs zero last year
items.quote: We are targeting a 60-40 BESS to solar EPC revenue mix, which will allow us to participate meaningfully in the country's rapidly expanding storage ecosystem, while building a more diversified and resilient revenue base.

items.statement: Raw material cost headwinds: copper up ~40%, aluminum up ~50%, steel prices increased since Oct 2025; INR depreciation from 85-86 to 96 impacting BESS imports
items.quote: To give you an example, copper compared to October 2025, copper is maybe up by about 40%. Aluminum is up by about 50%. There's been an increase in the steel prices.

items.statement: ALMM List 2 applicable from June 2025; 90-95% projects must shift to DCR cells; short-term cell shortage expected 6-12 months, easing by FY28

And MNRE to be honest after reviewing the extensions that have been granted, I think most 90% of the project will -- 90%, 95% of the project will have to shift to DCR cells.

items.statement: 100% of 600 MW NTPC REL module order to be supplied from in-house facility; broadening customer base across PSU and private to reduce concentration risk
items.quote: Ma'am 100%. I said 600 megawatt current order book. That entirely will come from the module line that we have.

items.statement: SJVN claims filed for INR219 crores; INR52 crores recorded as receivables; expects higher recovery including interest, idling charges, loss of profit
items.quote: We have raised a significant amount for loss and profit because of the delay in the project from SJVN, but that has to be seen how much of that amount is awarded to us actually.

items.statement: Net worth INR844.8 crores; debt-to-equity 0.3x as of March 31, 2026
items.quote: On the balance sheet side, for the year ended March 31, '26, our net worth stands at INR844.8 crores, while total debt-to-equity ratio stands at 0.3x.

items.statement: INR430 crores raised for 1.2 GW solar cell line; funds to be utilized in Q3 FY27 as construction starts and equipment ordered
items.quote: So the solar cell funds are dedicated to a very specific thing. Maybe we can use them for our utilities and for our machines. We are currently getting all our approvals and civil construction will start.

items.statement: BESS project timeline 11-12 months vs solar EPC 14 months; BESS projects have lower delay risk due to minimal land requirement
items.quote: BESS EPC we get about 11 to 12 months to execute. Solar EPC we get 14 months to execute. But in solar EPC, if there is a delay in handover of land, then we do get an extension in our timeline

items.statement: PPA signing delays after L1 bidding due to grid connectivity issues and BESS scaling; expects resolution by end FY27
items.quote: Secondly, on the PPAs getting rescinded by PSUs and DISCOMs, yes, that is a very, that is correct. And that is a problem that people are facing that PPAs are not getting signed after they become the L1 bidders in those bids.

items.statement: R&D spend not separately disclosed; continuous technical team effort targeting 700W panels from 620-625W; EPC-level optimization for cost and performance
items.quote: Our target this year has been to maybe shift from a 620, 625 watt solar panel to about a 700 watt solar panel, which very few people are doing at scale in India right now.

items.statement: Q4 FY26 revenue INR591 crores (+235% YoY); FY26 revenue INR1,416 crores (+1.57% YoY); internal target 40-45% growth in FY27
items.quote: We will maybe not be able to sustain this growth rate in the coming year. We expect to grow by around 40%-45% this year as well. And we hope to maintain it.

items.statement: DCR orders will be bid at current elevated prices with pass-through to developers; expects margins to improve as cell capacity and competition increase
items.quote: So if DCR had become applicable on my existing contract without any pass-through, that would be a problem. But I don't have any DCR orders. And as I pick up DCR orders now, I will definitely try to pick them up at the current prices.

items.statement: Well positioned as India's only EPC company backward integrated into manufacturing with ALMM module line and upcoming ALMM2 cell line

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 22-23% range for coming quarters
items.quote: I still want to reiterate that the EBITDA range would still remain in the 22% to 23% range.

items.statement: R&D spend guidance of INR5 billion over nine quarters FY26-FY27-Q1 FY28 remains on track
items.quote: We had mentioned previously that for the nine quarters FY26, FY 27, and Q1 of FY 28, our ta rgeted expected R&D spend is INR5 billion, INR500 crores. That remains high confidence; we are on track to achieve the R&D spend guidance for this nine -quarter cycle

items.statement: Projected capex of close to INR300 crores across various sites for next couple of years
items.quote: One is that for the next couple of year, we are projecting a capex of a close to INR300 crores across various sites.

items.statement: Pithampur facility general block expected to reach decent capacity utilization within 12-18 months post FDA inspection
items.quote: So, we will go as per our plan because, from a quality and standpoint also we want to ramp it up carefully. So, as soon as we get approval done, we have tech-transferred enough products for them to start manufacturing those products and reach a decent capacity utilization within 12 to 18 months.

items.statement: Pithampur facility ramp-up expected in Q1 CY2027
items.quote: Our initial indication that we were expecting a ramp-up in Q1 of CY27, calendar year 2027, still stays intact.

items.statement: Demand is broad-based across portfolio, not driven by single products or therapy areas
items.quote: Yes, so Harsh, demand has been very broad-based, and I don't think there is a single product or two products. We have seen business across products which have been in the market for a few years, and we have seen product demand for even products we have launched.

items.quote: So, in light of that, you know, we have seen a slightly slight decline in gross margins, which is because of our own manufacturing, internal manufacturing constraint and we had an increased reliance on the outsourced manufacturing.

items.statement: EBITDA margin at 23.1% in Q4 FY26, up sequentially
items.quote: So, for the current quarter, it is at 23.1%, so which has risen slightly on a sequential basis.

items.statement: 24 products under FDA review as of FY26, signaling robust pipeline
items.quote: The current number stands at 24 products which are under FDA review, which again signals a very robust pipeline for growth as we move into the next year.

items.statement: 12 product approvals received in FY26

items.quote: And also from a concentration perspective, the top 5 products account for 39% of revenue, again in line with our previous quarters, and the top 10 account for 57% of revenue, again clearly reflecting no concentration risk and in line with our earlier quarters.

items.statement: Borrowings reduced to INR2,594 million due to debt repayment
items.quote: Borrowings were at 2,594 million, a reduction versus the previous year on account of repayment of debt.

items.quote: Yeah, but also recently this Arinna acquisition, even that acquisition has been partly funded through debt. So, finance cost may not come down.

items.quote: In terms of deal contours, this was an enterprise value of INR200 crores on a cash and debt-free basis. We acquired an 85% stake in the company.

items.statement: M&A strategy is therapeutic-focused (CNS) rather than geography-focused

So, I wouldn't say it is a shift in strategy; I think we continue to execute on that journey of CNS, and so it adds one more avenue to monetize our portfolio and pipeline

items.statement: Board recommended dividend of 150% (INR1.5 per share), 10% payout ratio
items.quote: In line with what we have done even as an unlisted company, the board has recommended a dividend of 150%, which amounts to INR1.5 per share. This amounts to a 10.0% payout ratio.

Also, just to factor in, the P&L impact of this has been factored in the EBITDA guidance.

items.statement: R&D productivity improved to 5.9x for FY26 over FY23 period

items.statement: R&D productivity expected to remain at 5.0x or higher for subsequent R&D spend cycles
items.quote: Yeah. So, Tushar, I think that would be five and five plus would be a fair assumption. Obviously, our endeavor is to keep on improving and the kind of portfolio shift which we are seeing or the investments we are making, definitely we feel confident that will be beating that.

items.statement: EBITDA guidance of 22-23% includes ESOP, Arinna, Pithampur expenses and raw material cost escalation, excluding black swan events
items.quote: Yes, Tushar, you're right. Parag Sancheti: Except, Tushar, any black swan event which we can't predict

items.statement: Management expects to maintain the growth momentum of the last five years in FY27 and FY28.
items.quote: I think we are going to maintain the momentum which we have maintained in last five years. And although this is a forward-looking statement, but we will try to maintain the momentum which we have maintained in the last five years of our journey.

items.statement: Planned CAPEX of Rs. 20 crores over FY27 and FY28 for polymer additives capacity expansion.
items.quote: In FY27 and FY28, we are planning to invest approximately Rs. 20 crores in terms of CAPEX where we will increase our capacity in terms of manufacturing capability.

items.statement: Target to scale total manufacturing capacity to 18,000 metric tons in phased manner over next 12-18 months on newly acquired 9.6 acre land.
